newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged Friday, dealers said.

In fundamental news, Tunisia bought 14,000 tonnes of raw sugar at $276.90 per tonne C&F at a snap tender, traders in Tunis said. Shipment was for Sept 15-30. The name of the supplier was not disclosed.
Western Europe can expect rain throug the weekend, which should provide some relief to the crops that have suffered under a recent dry spell, Weather Services Corp said.
Thursday, front-month July closed 0.08 cent firmer at 10.84 cents per lb aafter trading from 10.85 to 10.73 cents. The rest settled 0.03 lower to 0.05 firmer.
Volume was estimated at only 6,753 lots.
Support remained at 10.65 cents, a low set on May 2, with resistance at 10.92 cents, where the July contract stalled Wednesday.

LIFFE white sugar futures were higher on Friday, with activity dominated by trading in the August/October spread. At 0845 EDT/1345 GMT, August stood $0.80 higher to $313.10, while the back months were $0.30 higher to down $0.80.
((-- S Rostler New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
